explanation: In day1, amount == quantity * unit_price exactly for all 200 rows (discount_pct is never applied). In day2 this invariant is broken for 16 of 200 rows (~8%): order_ids 2013, 2035, 2036, 2042, 2090, 2092, 2093, 2106, 2113, 2128, 2132, 2143, 2155, 2166, 2168, 2189, where amount exceeds quantity*unit_price by a variable ~4-9%. The inflation is not a constant factor, not a unit/sign change, and does not correlate with discount_pct, suggesting an undocumented surcharge/tax leaking into amount or a partial rollout of a new amount formula. Schema, dtypes, date format, enums, null rates, and discount_pct are otherwise unchanged. Downstream revenue reconciliation, per-unit price derivation, and margin analytics will be silently corrupted on the affected rows (revenue overstated), while the 92% of clean rows let naive checks pass.
